reading.title: Mia Reads About Frogs
reading.purpose: Follow Mia as she reads a page about frogs.
paras: Mia reads the heading: Frogs. "The topic is frogs," says Mr. Lee. Mia looks at the diagram. Each label names a part of the frog.
She reads the caption under the photo. A detail says a frog begins as a tiny egg. That is a fact. Mia says, "My opinion is that frogs are great!"

choices: is true and can be checked.
qs.why: A frog begins as a tiny egg can be checked, so it is a fact.

choices: A frog begins as a tiny egg.
qs.why: Mia says frogs are great. That is what she feels, so it is an opinion.

qs.q: What names each part in the diagram?
qs.why: The reading says each label names a part of the frog.
